				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {

					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m254_receipt_subject

					EXPECTED_STATE = 1

# #255 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m255_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m255_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m255_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m255_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m255_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m255_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 255 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m255_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m255_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m255_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m255_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m255_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_compare_workforce_tco_255
				has_variable = zg361_we_m255_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m255_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m255_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ac_owner
			var:zg361_we_m255_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ac_subject
			var:zg361_we_m255_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m255_write_case = var:zg361_case_ac_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m255_write_state = var:zg361_case_ac_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m255_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_object_workforce_tco_comparison
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_resource_gold
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_resource_hc
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_resource_shadow_hc
						}
					var:zg361_we_m255_object_type_code = 255
					var:zg361_we_m255_consumer_contract = 255
					var:zg361_we_m255_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m255_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m255_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m255_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m255_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m255_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m255_object_case = var:zg361_we_m255_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m255_object_state = var:zg361_we_m255_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m255_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m255_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m255_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m255_debt_type_code = 255
					var:zg361_we_m255_debt_consumer_contract = 255
					var:zg361_we_m255_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m255_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m255_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m255_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m255_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m255_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m255_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m255_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m255_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m255_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m255_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m255_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m255_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m255_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m255_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m255_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m255_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m255_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m255_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m255_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m255_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m255_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m255_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m255_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m255_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m255_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m255_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m255_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m255_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m255_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m255_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m255_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m255_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m255_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_compare_workforce_tco_255 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m255_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m255_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m255_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m255_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m255_consumer_compare_workforce_tco_255 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m255_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #255 route A: guard -> atomic precheck -> receipt -> write -> consumer.

	remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
	remove_variable = zg361_we_last_red_code

	if = {
		limit = {

				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_state

# #260 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m260_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m260_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m260_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m260_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m260_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m260_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 260 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m260_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m260_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m260_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m260_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m260_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_lock_contract_type_260
				has_variable = zg361_we_m260_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m260_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m260_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ac_owner
			var:zg361_we_m260_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ac_subject
			var:zg361_we_m260_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m260_write_case = var:zg361_case_ac_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m260_write_state = var:zg361_case_ac_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m260_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_object_contract_type_lock
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_resource_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_resource_change
						}
					var:zg361_we_m260_object_type_code = 260
					var:zg361_we_m260_consumer_contract = 260
					var:zg361_we_m260_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m260_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m260_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m260_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m260_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m260_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m260_object_case = var:zg361_we_m260_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m260_object_state = var:zg361_we_m260_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m260_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m260_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m260_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m260_debt_type_code = 260
					var:zg361_we_m260_debt_consumer_contract = 260
					var:zg361_we_m260_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m260_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m260_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m260_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m260_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m260_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m260_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m260_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m260_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m260_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m260_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m260_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m260_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m260_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m260_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m260_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m260_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m260_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m260_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m260_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m260_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m260_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m260_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m260_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m260_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m260_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m260_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m260_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m260_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m260_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m260_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m260_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m260_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m260_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_lock_contract_type_260 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m260_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m260_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m260_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m260_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m260_consumer_lock_contract_type_260 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m260_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #261 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m261_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m261_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m261_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m261_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m261_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m261_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 261 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m261_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m261_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m261_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m261_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m261_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_disclose_executor_chain_261
				has_variable = zg361_we_m261_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m261_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m261_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ac_owner
			var:zg361_we_m261_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ac_subject
			var:zg361_we_m261_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m261_write_case = var:zg361_case_ac_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m261_write_state = var:zg361_case_ac_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m261_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_object_executor_chain
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_resource_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_resource_provenance
						}
					var:zg361_we_m261_object_type_code = 261
					var:zg361_we_m261_consumer_contract = 261
					var:zg361_we_m261_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m261_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m261_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m261_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m261_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m261_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m261_object_case = var:zg361_we_m261_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m261_object_state = var:zg361_we_m261_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m261_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m261_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m261_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m261_debt_type_code = 261
					var:zg361_we_m261_debt_consumer_contract = 261
					var:zg361_we_m261_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m261_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m261_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m261_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m261_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m261_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m261_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m261_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m261_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m261_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m261_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m261_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m261_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m261_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m261_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m261_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m261_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m261_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m261_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m261_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m261_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m261_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m261_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m261_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m261_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m261_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m261_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m261_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m261_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m261_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m261_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m261_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m261_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m261_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_disclose_executor_chain_261 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m261_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m261_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m261_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m261_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m261_consumer_disclose_executor_chain_261 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m261_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #261 route A: guard -> atomic precheck -> receipt -> write -> consumer.

# #256 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m256_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m256_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m256_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m256_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m256_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m256_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 256 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m256_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m256_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m256_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m256_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m256_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_evaluate_supplier_pool_256
				has_variable = zg361_we_m256_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m256_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m256_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ac_owner
			var:zg361_we_m256_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ac_subject
			var:zg361_we_m256_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m256_write_case = var:zg361_case_ac_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m256_write_state = var:zg361_case_ac_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m256_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_object_supplier_scorecard
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_resource_supplier
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_resource_external_score
						}
					var:zg361_we_m256_object_type_code = 256
					var:zg361_we_m256_consumer_contract = 256
					var:zg361_we_m256_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m256_write_owner

					var:zg361_we_m256_object_state = var:zg361_we_m256_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_debt_subject

						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m256_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m256_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m256_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m256_debt_type_code = 256
					var:zg361_we_m256_debt_consumer_contract = 256
					var:zg361_we_m256_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m256_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m256_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m256_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m256_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m256_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m256_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m256_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m256_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m256_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m256_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m256_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m256_consumed_state

					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m256_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m256_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m256_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m256_write_subject

					var:zg361_we_m256_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m256_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m256_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m256_write_state

		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m256_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m256_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m256_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m256_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m256_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_evaluate_supplier_pool_256 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m256_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m256_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m256_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m256_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m256_consumer_evaluate_supplier_pool_256 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m256_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #258 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m258_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m258_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m258_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m258_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m258_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m258_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 258 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m258_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m258_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m258_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m258_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m258_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_freeze_controllable_scope_258
				has_variable = zg361_we_m258_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m258_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m258_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ac_owner
			var:zg361_we_m258_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ac_subject
			var:zg361_we_m258_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m258_write_case = var:zg361_case_ac_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m258_write_state = var:zg361_case_ac_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m258_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_object_controllable_scope_snapshot
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_resource_access
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_resource_target
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_resource_governance
						}
					var:zg361_we_m258_object_type_code = 258
					var:zg361_we_m258_consumer_contract = 258
					var:zg361_we_m258_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m258_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m258_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m258_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m258_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m258_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m258_object_case = var:zg361_we_m258_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m258_object_state = var:zg361_we_m258_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m258_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m258_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m258_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m258_debt_type_code = 258
					var:zg361_we_m258_debt_consumer_contract = 258
					var:zg361_we_m258_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m258_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m258_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m258_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m258_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m258_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m258_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m258_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m258_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m258_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m258_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m258_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m258_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m258_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m258_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m258_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m258_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m258_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m258_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m258_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m258_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m258_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m258_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m258_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m258_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m258_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m258_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m258_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_freeze_controllable_scope_258 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m258_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m258_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_consumer_freeze_controllable_scope_258 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #259 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m259_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m259_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m259_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m259_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m259_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m259_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 259 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m259_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m259_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m259_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m259_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m259_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_allocate_sla_responsibility_259
				has_variable = zg361_we_m259_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m259_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m259_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ac_owner
			var:zg361_we_m259_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ac_subject
			var:zg361_we_m259_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m259_write_case = var:zg361_case_ac_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m259_write_state = var:zg361_case_ac_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m259_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_object_sla_liability_allocation
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_resource_sla
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_resource_liability
						}
					var:zg361_we_m259_object_type_code = 259
					var:zg361_we_m259_consumer_contract = 259
					var:zg361_we_m259_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m259_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m259_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m259_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m259_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m259_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m259_object_case = var:zg361_we_m259_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m259_object_state = var:zg361_we_m259_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m259_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m259_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m259_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m259_debt_type_code = 259
					var:zg361_we_m259_debt_consumer_contract = 259
					var:zg361_we_m259_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m259_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m259_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m259_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m259_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m259_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m259_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m259_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m259_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m259_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m259_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m259_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m259_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m259_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m259_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m259_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m259_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m259_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m259_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m259_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m259_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m259_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m259_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m259_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m259_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m259_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m259_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m259_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m259_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m259_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m259_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m259_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m259_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m259_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_allocate_sla_responsibility_259 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m259_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m259_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m259_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m259_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m259_consumer_allocate_sla_responsibility_259 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m259_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #257 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m257_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m257_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m257_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m257_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m257_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m257_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 257 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m257_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m257_write_subject

				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m257_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ac_owner
			var:zg361_we_m257_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ac_subject
			var:zg361_we_m257_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m257_write_case = var:zg361_case_ac_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m257_write_state = var:zg361_case_ac_state
				trigger_if = {

						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m257_object_type_code

						}

					var:zg361_we_m257_consumer_contract = 257
					var:zg361_we_m257_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m257_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m257_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m257_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m257_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m257_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m257_object_case = var:zg361_we_m257_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m257_object_state = var:zg361_we_m257_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m257_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m257_debt_subject

						}
					var:zg361_we_m257_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m257_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m257_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m257_debt_type_code = 257
					var:zg361_we_m257_debt_consumer_contract = 257
					var:zg361_we_m257_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m257_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m257_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m257_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m257_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m257_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m257_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m257_write_case

					var:zg361_we_m257_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m257_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {

					var:zg361_we_m257_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m257_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m257_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m257_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m257_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m257_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m257_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m257_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m257_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m257_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m257_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m257_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m257_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_convert_external_worker_257 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m257_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m257_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m257_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m257_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m257_consumer_convert_external_worker_257 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m257_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #262 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m262_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m262_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m262_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m262_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m262_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m262_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 262 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m262_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m262_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m262_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m262_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m262_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_open_secondment_review_262
				has_variable = zg361_we_m262_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m262_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m262_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ac_owner
			var:zg361_we_m262_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ac_subject
			var:zg361_we_m262_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m262_write_case = var:zg361_case_ac_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m262_write_state = var:zg361_case_ac_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m262_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_object_secondment_review
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_resource_secondment
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_resource_capacity
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_resource_credit
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_object_due_cycle
						}
					var:zg361_we_m262_object_type_code = 262
					var:zg361_we_m262_consumer_contract = 262
					var:zg361_we_m262_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m262_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m262_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m262_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m262_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m262_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m262_object_case = var:zg361_we_m262_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m262_object_state = var:zg361_we_m262_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m262_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m262_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m262_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m262_debt_type_code = 262
					var:zg361_we_m262_debt_consumer_contract = 262
					var:zg361_we_m262_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m262_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m262_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m262_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m262_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m262_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m262_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m262_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m262_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m262_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m262_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m262_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m262_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m262_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m262_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m262_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m262_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m262_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m262_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m262_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m262_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m262_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m262_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m262_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m262_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m262_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m262_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m262_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_open_secondment_review_262 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m262_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m262_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_consumer_open_secondment_review_262 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #262 route A: guard -> atomic precheck -> receipt -> write -> consumer.
zg361_we_m262_route_a_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
	remove_variable = zg361_we_last_red_code
zg361_we_ac_freeze_m262_host_manager_effect = {
	TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
	TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
	TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
	TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
}
	if = {

						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m262_receipt_subject

						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m262_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m262_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m262_receipt_case

						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

						EXPECTED_STATE = 4
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m262_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m262_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m262_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m262_receipt_case

						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3

			}
			trigger_if = {

					has_variable = zg361_we_operation_total
					has_variable = zg361_we_operation_used
					has_variable = zg361_we_ac_external_secondment_host_manager
				}
				var:zg361_we_operation_used < var:zg361_we_operation_total
				trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m262_review_pending } var:zg361_we_m262_review_pending = 0 } trigger_else = { always = yes }
				var:zg361_we_ac_external_secondment_host_manager = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { var:zg361_we_ac_external_secondment_host_manager = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				NOT = { var:zg361_we_ac_external_secondment_host_manager = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ac_owner

			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m262_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m262_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m262_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m262_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m262_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = 4
			OPERATION_ID = 262
			CHOICE = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_applied value = 1 }

			change_variable = { name = zg361_we_operation_used add = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_choice value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_business_object_created value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_object_type_code value = 262 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_object_secondment_review value = 1 }

# #263 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m263_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m263_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m263_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m263_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m263_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m263_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 263 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m263_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m263_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m263_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m263_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m263_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_resolve_secondment_return_263
				has_variable = zg361_we_m263_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m263_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m263_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ac_owner
			var:zg361_we_m263_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ac_subject
			var:zg361_we_m263_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m263_write_case = var:zg361_case_ac_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m263_write_state = var:zg361_case_ac_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m263_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_object_secondment_return
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_resource_secondment
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_resource_deadline
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_resource_workforce
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_object_due_cycle
						}
					var:zg361_we_m263_object_type_code = 263
					var:zg361_we_m263_consumer_contract = 263
					var:zg361_we_m263_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m263_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m263_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m263_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m263_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m263_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m263_object_case = var:zg361_we_m263_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m263_object_state = var:zg361_we_m263_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_debt_due_cycle

						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m263_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m263_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m263_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m263_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m263_debt_type_code = 263

					var:zg361_we_m263_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m263_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m263_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m263_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m263_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m263_write_case

				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {

					var:zg361_we_m263_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m263_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m263_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m263_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m263_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m263_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m263_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m263_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m263_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m263_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m263_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m263_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m263_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_resolve_secondment_return_263 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m263_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m263_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m263_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m263_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m263_consumer_resolve_secondment_return_263 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m263_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #264 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m264_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m264_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m264_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m264_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m264_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m264_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 264 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m264_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m264_write_subject

				has_variable = zg361_we_m264_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m264_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ac_owner
			var:zg361_we_m264_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ac_subject
			var:zg361_we_m264_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m264_write_case = var:zg361_case_ac_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m264_write_state = var:zg361_case_ac_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m264_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m264_object_type_code

					var:zg361_we_m264_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m264_write_cycle

				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {

					var:zg361_we_m264_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m264_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m264_debt_type_code = 264
					var:zg361_we_m264_debt_consumer_contract = 264
					var:zg361_we_m264_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m264_write_owner

						has_variable = zg361_we_m264_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m264_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m264_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m264_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m264_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m264_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m264_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m264_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m264_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m264_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m264_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m264_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m264_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m264_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m264_write_state

		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m264_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m264_write_subject }

		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m264_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}

# #265 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m265_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m265_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m265_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m265_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m265_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m265_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 265 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m265_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m265_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m265_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m265_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m265_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_audit_external_fraud_265
				has_variable = zg361_we_m265_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m265_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ac_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m265_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ac_owner
			var:zg361_we_m265_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ac_subject
			var:zg361_we_m265_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m265_write_case = var:zg361_case_ac_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m265_write_state = var:zg361_case_ac_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m265_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_object_fraud_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_resource_gold
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_resource_liability
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_resource_evidence
						}
					var:zg361_we_m265_object_type_code = 265
					var:zg361_we_m265_consumer_contract = 265
					var:zg361_we_m265_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m265_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m265_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m265_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m265_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m265_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m265_object_case = var:zg361_we_m265_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m265_object_state = var:zg361_we_m265_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m265_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m265_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m265_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m265_debt_type_code = 265
					var:zg361_we_m265_debt_consumer_contract = 265
					var:zg361_we_m265_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m265_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m265_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m265_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m265_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m265_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m265_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m265_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m265_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m265_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m265_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m265_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m265_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m265_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m265_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m265_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m265_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m265_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m265_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m265_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m265_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m265_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m265_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m265_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m265_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m265_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m265_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m265_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m265_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m265_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m265_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m265_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m265_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m265_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_audit_external_fraud_265 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m265_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m265_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m265_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m265_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m265_consumer_audit_external_fraud_265 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m265_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

							RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m265_receipt_subject

					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$

				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
					zg361_we_release_abandoned_ac_resources_effect = yes
					zg361_we_ad_launch_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {

			NOT = {

						has_variable = zg361_we_operation_used
					}
					var:zg361_we_operation_used < var:zg361_we_operation_total
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 2653 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } # typed RED, no receipt or business write
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ac_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ac_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial

	else_if = {
		limit = {
